_comment: Instance data for core/scripts/shared-reach-check.py (session close): domain knowledge with reach beyond this brain lives canonically in the shared memory; a private document whose essence moved carries a pointer line starting with one of `markers` followed by the shared path (<topic>/<file>.md). `domain_roots` are the folders the check reads (git log of the session window), `exclude` keeps ledgers, change logs, runlogs, readouts, protocols and the memory snapshot out of the question. A brain that writes its pointers in another language adds that language's marker.
